JoJo · AI says:

Yes, damaged items are handled differently from a normal return.

Normal return: We accept unused items in original packaging within 30 days; return shipping is the customer’s responsibility.
Damaged/faulty item (delivery issue): You should contact our support team with details and photos. If the item is faulty or sent incorrectly, return shipping costs may be reimbursed and resolutions can include replacement, refund, or redelivery.
